items.title: Warren Buffett’s Thanksgiving Message Names a Teacher Most Investors Have Never Heard Of. At 63 He Bought 300 Berkshire Shares That Would Be Worth $260 Million Today
items.summary: Warren Buffett's Thanksgiving message thanks Joe Rosenfield, who at 63 bought 300 Berkshire shares for Grinnell College for $5,252. The college sold them. Today they would be worth about $260 million.

items.title: The Buffett Indicator Is Flashing Red. These 2 Dividend Stocks Could Be Safe Havens.
items.summary: The Buffett indicator is well above its long-term average, so you may want to consider buying stocks of companies that sell things people don't want to live without.

items.title: Charlie Munger Said BYD Was ‘So Much Ahead Of Tesla, It’s Almost Ridiculous’ in 2023. BYD Then Outsold Tesla, But Berkshire Sold Every Share.
items.summary: BYD sold around 600,000 more pure-electric cars in 2025 than Tesla; Berkshire's 2008 BYD stake, bought for about $230 million, was sold off by September 2025.

items.title: Kroger Just Raised Its Dividend 11% as Shoppers Grow More Price Sensitive
items.summary: Kroger has raised its payout for 20 straight years, but shoppers are filling their carts with fewer items and sales growth has nearly stalled. Can retirees still count on the checks, and which number should they watch next?

items.title: Is Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B) Reasonable After A Record Cash Pile?
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway has delivered a strong run over the past few years, which puts the spotlight squarely on whether the current share price is supported by the returns it earns on its vast pool of capital. With a long track record of reinvesting cash inside the business rather than paying a dividend, the central question for investors is what those reinvested dollars are actually earning today. items.title: I'm an Investing Expert: What Warren Buffett's Cash Stockpile Says About Stocks
items.summary: What can everyday investors take away from Berkshire Hathaway's enormous cash reserve, and what does it say about today's stock market? Is it good or bad?

items.title: Berkshire Gains 15% YTD, Outperforms Industry: Time to Buy the Stock?
items.summary: BRK.B gains 15.3% YTD, backed by diversified earnings, strong finances and improving analyst sentiment. But does its premium valuation justify buying?

items.title: ‘I’d Be Having My Thanksgiving Dinner at McDonald’s’: Warren Buffett Credited ‘Uncle Sam’ for Saving His Holiday — And the U.S. Economy
items.summary: Buffett credited the U.S. government’s 2008 bailout response with preventing a financial collapse that could have changed everything.
